title: Comparative evaluation of mixed reality, CTA-based digital guide, and hand-held Doppler for anterolateral thigh perforator localization in head and neck reconstruction
html: Accurate perforator localization is critical for safe and efficient harvest of the anterolateral thigh perforator flap (ALTF) in head and neck reconstruction. This study evaluated the feasibility and accuracy of computed tomography angiography (CTA) with integrated mixed reality (CTA-MR) for perforator localization compared with hand-held Doppler ultrasound (HHD) and CTA-based digital guides (CTA-guide). Twelve patients requiring ALTF reconstruction following oral and maxillofacial tumour resection were enrolled.
